name: admit-one-ticket
description: Notched event ticket with a perforated admit-one stub, dithered stock, pointer tilt, and a glare that tracks the pointer.
purpose: Puts a physical door pass on an event landing so visitors can read presenter, guest, venue, and stub copy at ticket proportions.
bestFor: limited-entry drops that need a memorable pass
avoidFor: task-heavy product UI where pointer tilt would compete with controls
